latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — adds complete GoHighLevel CRM API v2 integration for OpenClaw agents:

- Manage contacts, pipelines, conversations (SMS/email/WhatsApp), calendars, appointments, and workflows via the GHL API v2.
- Supports searching, creating, updating, and deleting contacts and opportunities.
- Enables sending and retrieving messages, booking appointments, and managing calendar slots.
- Includes detailed command-line examples and authentication setup.
- Handles API rate limits with automatic retries.
